title: Introduce aggregate session token rollups and prompt-shape cohort heatmap
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Added aggregate per-session token rollups, a prompt-shape cohort heatmap dashboard, and updated alerts to use percentile-based tuning for token-cost excursions.
description:
Motivation: Investigations of long-tail cost spikes showed that many high-cost invocations cluster by prompt shape and session lifetime. This PR introduces per-session token rollup aggregation, prompt-shape tagging on spans, and a Grafana cohort heatmap to make those clusters visible.

What this changes: Adds a session-aggregator that computes per-session token_count and token_cost_usd rollups at 1m and 5m windows; enriches OTEL spans with prompt_shape and token_cost_usd attributes; exposes new metrics (redwood.inference.session_token_rollup.count, redwood.inference.session_token_rollup.cost_usd, redwood.inference.prompt_shape.cardinality); introduces a cohorted heatmap panel and a summary widget for top prompt-shapes by cost. Replaces the previous static alert on average token cost with a percentile-based alert (P95 over rolling 30m 3-hour lookback) with dampening to reduce noisy flaps.

Checklist: [x] Instrument rollup producer and consumer [x] Add span enrichment in runtime path [x] Add Grafana dashboard JSON + panels [x] Add unit + small e2e telemetry smoke tests [x] Update docs and runbook entries [x] Add migration to backfill historic 7d aggregates (small job included)

Why this is safe: Aggregations are additive and non-destructive. Rollup emission runs as opt-in; default is off for new clusters until customers enable in console. Backfill job runs at low priority and has throttling. Alert thresholds are initially conservative and documented in runbook.

Related: ENG-4127 (observability backlog item), SUP-1283 (support case that triggered investigation).
